source: Original synthetic examples written independently of the classifier training agent; no private conversations or recordings.
policyDefinition: When the named topic is enabled, hide the complete sentence that discusses it, including denial, quote, education, public information and legitimate discussion. A topic match never establishes guilt or confidentiality. Preserve unrelated sentences and homonymous non-topic uses. Literal/morphological dictionary modes intentionally have different scope and may hide a homonym when the user explicitly entered that word.
evaluationNotes: Do not tune model weights, thresholds or catalog rules on this set and then report its results as unseen.
Gold labels are authored hypotheses, not human-adjudicated truth; blinded judges may flag disputed cases.
Only compare classifier performance on topics actually supported by its frozen artifact; report unsupported topics separately.
Keep lexical-stage token masking metrics separate from topic-stage sentence masking metrics.
ASR examples are synthetic text perturbations; no microphone or acoustic inference was measured.
